dedupe_keys.name: points de reperes des routes departementales de l aude

description: Points de repères des routes départementales de l'Aude is a dataset listed in CD11 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de l'Aude. Liste des points de repères le long des routes matérialisé par une borne ou une plaquette du Département de l'Aude. Coverage: Aude. The portal files it under routes / transports. Its keywords are route, route départementale, réseau routier, référentiel routier, point repère, pr. The portal shows 5,383 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-aude-fr-portal.
